attempts.note: No HTTP client in src/ (no fetch/request/undici); every export is a pure transform. All 5 ast.json operations modelled from Adaptor.js, VaroEmsUtils.js, FridgeTagUtils.js, StreamingUtils.js, Utils.js and test fixtures.
No Varo cold-chain API anywhere; the adaptor's I/O is Gmail attachments and OpenFn Collections, which have their own adaptors/specs.
Only unrelated entries (Varo Bank is a different company).

notes: The Varo adaptor (v2.2.3) has no network target: it converts Varo/FridgeTag cold-chain files pulled from Gmail into WHO EMS reports and back into Varo email packages, alongside the gmail and collections adaptors. This synthesized spec models all 5 ast.json operations as local POST placeholders (x-openfn-local-operations) whose body is the arguments and whose 200 body is the state.data result or return value; it is complete because the operation surface is bounded and every function was read. Corrected from the July 2026 stub: convertToEms and convertItemsToReports return arrays of EmsReport (not records/one report), convertReportsToMessageContents takes and returns arrays and includes the plain-text body, isKeyInRange returns a bare boolean, and the EMS report/record schemas now list the adaptor's full field whitelists plus its z-prefixed extensions. parseUtcForDataRange and isKeyInRange are plain functions, not state operations. EMS field meanings come from the adaptor's comments where present; the rest are labelled undocumented rather than guessed.
